settings.accent_tip: Color of the frame and selected buttons
settings.accent_tip_plain: The frame is neutral in this style; the color stays on selected buttons
settings.auto_save: Save every screenshot automatically (the file is updated after edits in the editor)
settings.both_layouts: Applies to both layouts at once: Latin and the same key on the Russian layout (Alt+W and Alt+Ц)
settings.color_field: Color of the area around the screenshot
settings.email_bad: That does not look like an email: it should look like name@gmail.com.
settings.email_ok: Email accepted. Click “Save” below: the MyMemory limit becomes 50,000 characters a day.
settings.frame_inactive_tip: Not in effect: the frame style “No colored frame” is selected
settings.frame_style_tip: Thin line with a glow, thick rounded, or no colored frame
settings.google_off: not connected: 500,000 characters a month free, a key is needed
settings.google_tip: A window with the steps: Google Cloud project, billing for verification, translation service, key
settings.hotkey_hint: Build your own shortcut step by step: select the Ctrl, Shift, Alt, and/or Win modifier keys you need (you can choose several; for example, Ctrl+Alt+W uses three keys) and pick a key from the list: letters, digits, F1-F24, Home, End, Page Up/Down, symbols. Or press “Record…” and press all keys in the combination together. The keyboard layout does not matter: Alt+W and Alt+Ц are the same.
settings.next_shot: Takes effect for the next screenshot
settings.ocr_accurate: More accurate: the image is enlarged before reading (slower)
settings.ocr_enable: Enable: “Copy text” when taking a screenshot (Ctrl+T) and in the editor (I key)
settings.ocr_fast: Faster: no enlargement (small text is read less well)
settings.ocr_idle: While recognition is not in use, it takes no memory or processor time: the recognition program starts only when you press the button.
settings.ocr_more_text: Russian and English are recognized now. Bulgarian is read through Russian with errors in some letters, and German and French lose umlauts and accents. Languages are installed once with the command below.
settings.ocr_more_title: Recognizing other languages: Bulgarian, German, French and more
settings.press_text:
Press the key combination you want to use (for example, Alt+W).
This window closes automatically.
settings.record_tip: Press all keys in the shortcut together
settings.remember: Highlight the previous area (Enter or a click inside captures the same one)
settings.reset_theme: Restore colors of the chosen style
settings.save_ask: “Save” (Ctrl+S) saves straight to this folder without asking where
settings.show_zoom: Magnifier with coordinates and pixel color
settings.system_title: System title bar of the editor window
settings.system_title_tip:
Off by default: the window has its own header and rounded corners.
When on, the system title bar is back; applies to new windows.
settings.title: ClipSD: settings
settings.tr_alt: If the text is already in that language, translate to:
settings.tr_email_check_tip: A trial translation with this email: MyMemory tells you right away whether it accepted it
settings.tr_email_tip: The email is sent only to MyMemory, together with translation requests. No confirmation is needed.
settings.tr_enable: Enable: the “Translate” button when taking a screenshot (Ctrl+L), the translation is placed over the text
settings.tr_note: If the selected service has run out of its limit or Google is not connected, the translation automatically goes through the other one. The text to translate is sent over the internet to the selected service.
settings.tray_click: When you click the tray icon:
settings.update_check_tip: Once a day, ClipSD checks clipsd.github.io for a new version and offers to install it. To check manually, open the tray icon menu and select “Check for updates”.
